sourceGaps: The obtained source is The Competition Problems from the International Chemistry Olympiads, Volume 3, edited by Anton Sirota, IUVENTA/IChO International Information Centre, Bratislava 2014. This is the collection edition of the printed44th IChO,21–30July2012,Washington,U.S.A.; not an obtained complete original competitor packet. Original grading points, selected practical grading graphs and data-dependent solution portions are editorially omitted. Every question, method, printed key, rubric, diagram, chemical list and blank form actually printed in physical163–220 is retained.

Theory2.3 refers to an optional grid not supplied. Theory7 and8.6 refer to answer boxes not printed. The actual anthracene energy-level form, spectra, practical recording tables and mechanism forms are supplied and retained. Separate answer sheets, exact laboratory bottle-label values and competitor measurements are not invented.

Practical1.1–1.3 require competitor measurements and their calculations; the collection key begins1.4 and supplies no fabricated experimental records. Practical2.1 and2.3 lack worked numerical answers; key2.4 lists three maximum-point conditions without numerical allocations. Source key2.5 provides the actualRf ranges. All printed methods and rubrics are retained.

Printed Volume3 teaching copying/distribution/transmission/adaptation grant requires the Volume3 attribution. Commercial publication/distribution requires a copyright-holder waiver. Attribution, source edition2014 and commercial restriction are retained; organizer hosting, unrestricted commercial use and completeness of the original2012 packet are not asserted.

Only new physical166–22055pages were personally read in this pass. Historical common1–5 and the same reader’s previously read held163–165 are reused with zero fresh credit. These now complete the printed2012 cover and eight theory/two practical whole tasks with their matching keys. Physical221–29171pages remain unread/unclaimed and the parent compilation unresolved.
